prompts.eruption: Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset, original pixel-art FX spritesheet on true transparent background. Reference image is style/context only: left old fire eruption, middle old fire vortex, right water vortex. Create ONLY a NEW FIRE ERUPTION for Spirit Gate skill F4, much more detailed and readable than reference: an explosive volcanic flame column emerging from a low oval ground fissure, orange-red tongues, hot yellow core, angular embers, no rocks that linger. 2D top-down three-quarter RPG camera, crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no text, no grid lines, no characters. EXACTLY 12 animation frames on a strict equal 4 column by 3 row grid, read left to right top to bottom. Fixed camera and FIXED ground anchor at local 50% width 82% height in EVERY cell; fixed scale across frames, no autozoom or crop. Entire art stays within inner 75% width and 75% height of each cell. Sequence: frame1 only tiny ember crack, frame2 small flame bud, frame3 rising flame, frame4 half height blast, frames5/6 huge impressive peak eruption, frame7 tapering flame, frame8 lower flame, frame9 sparse tongues, frame10 scattered few embers, frame11 tiny sparks, frame12 only 2-4 faint small embers at root. Last frame MUST be as tiny as first. No repeated full-size vortex, this is an eruption that starts and ends at almost nothing. Transparent negative space in each cell, no matte, no checkerboard painted. Make all 12 frames visibly separated by generous transparent gutters. Wide sheet aspect 4:3.
prompts.water: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D RPG pixel-art game FX spritesheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Reference image: right water vortex is visual style/color reference; create a new WATER VORTEX animation with beautiful crisp detailed azure/cyan/white pixel clusters, foamy spiral bands rising above an oval pool, same top-down three-quarter camera. ONLY water, no fire or character. EXACTLY 12 equally sized frames arranged in a STRICT 4 columns x3 rows grid read left-right top-bottom. Each cell shares the SAME ground anchor at local x50%, y82%, fixed camera, fixed scale; do NOT enlarge tiny stages to fill their cells. Transparent padding at least12% on all sides, no strokes crossing cells, no text or separator lines. Lifecycle, not a loop: 1 tiny few droplets at ground root, 2 tiny spiral ripple, 3 ankle-height swirl, 4 half-height spinning water column, 5 almost full, 6 full impressive spiral vortex apex, 7 full vortex rotates, 8 shrinking half-height vortex, 9 low spiral pool, 10 dissolving spray, 11 tiny ripple and 3 drops, 12 only2-4 tiny residual droplets. First/last frames MUST occupy less than10% of full peak area. Growth and decline happen by genuinely changing the water shape, not just shrinking a copy. Keep the detailed beautiful look of the reference water. Ground pool must be centered on the common anchor in all frames. Background must be transparent alpha, no painted checkerboard, no blur, no gradient backdrop, no ice. Wide 4:3 sheet.
prompts.fire: Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D RPG FIRE VORTEX FX spritesheet, true transparent alpha. Reference image middle is old fire vortex style hint, right demonstrates richer detail desired. Create ONLY new fire vortex with bright yellow hot cores, orange-red flame spiral bands and scattered angular sparks, swirling around an empty central axis above a horizontal elliptical flame ring. Top-down three-quarter camera, crisp detailed pixel clusters, no blur, no character, no scenery, no ice, no water. EXACTLY 12 frames in a strict equal 4 columns by3 rows grid read left to right then next row. Fixed camera and fixed scale throughout. Common FIXED ground anchor at local cell x50%, y82%. Every effect wholly within its cell with 12% transparent gutters. No grid lines/text, no checkerboard matte. Animation is a full one-shot birth to death: frame1 few tiny sparks at ground, frame2 tiny flame ring, frame3 low swirl, frame4 half-height flaming spiral, frame5 growing nearfull, frame6 impressive full-height spinning fire vortex, frame7 rotates fullheight, frame8 shrinks to halfheight, frame9 collapses into low spiral flame, frame10 sparse fading flame wisps, frame11 few tiny embers, frame12 only2-4 tiny final embers at ground. Tiny beginning and ending stages MUST occupy under10% of peak area, DO NOT zoom these stages up to fill their cells. Use genuinely different flame shapes for each stage, not simple scaled duplicates. No opaque background. Wide 4:3 sheet.
